sources.title: Amlan Ganguly — RIT Directory
sources.author: Rochester Institute of Technology
sources.content: Amlan Ganguly's research includes energy-efficient interconnection architectures for multicore chips using wireless and photonic interconnects, along with robust and failure-resistant networks-on-chip.

sources.title: RIT Computer Engineering

sources.content: RIT computer engineering connects computer architecture, embedded systems, communications, and networking to the design of computing systems.
